assertions.assertion: Mentions audience mismatch as a common cause — Audience in JwtBearerOptions must match the ApiResource name in IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: Section 1 states JwtBearerOptions.Audience must exactly match the ApiResource name (the aud claim), calls it the most common cause, and advises decoding the token to compare.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the importance of ValidTypes = ['at+jwt'] and warns about JWT confusion attacks without it
assertions.rationale: Section 2 covers ValidTypes = ["at+jwt"] and explicitly warns that omitting it enables JWT confusion attacks where an identity token is replayed as an access token.

assertions.assertion: Mentions scope claim format inconsistency — space-delimited vs array — as a cause of silent authorization failures
assertions.rationale: Section 3 explains scope may be a JSON array or a space-delimited string and that RequireClaim then fails silently; recommends an IClaimsTransformation to normalize.

assertions.assertion: Mentions checking the middleware pipeline ordering (UseAuthentication before UseAuthorization)
assertions.rationale: Section 4 states UseAuthentication() must come before UseAuthorization() and shows the correct order.
